capturedSource.basis: Immutable git archive of supervisor/go.mod, supervisor/go.sum, and supervisor/internal/audit from baseCommit, with only the two listed audit source files overlaid.
capturedSource.isolation: Tests ran from a private /tmp extraction, not the mutable checkout. Go module cache was read-only via GOPROXY=off, GOSUMDB=off, GOFLAGS=-mod=readonly.

change.api: Journal.RunEffectWithBeforeOutcome invokes a supplied hook after the callback returns and before appending its outcome; hook failure or panic poisons the journal, withholds callback result bytes, and leaves the durable intent unresolved.
change.orderingRegression: Inside the hook, the test verifies the synced trace has exactly one unresolved intent, no outcome sequence, and exactly one sync. It also checks callback-before-hook and the eventual successful outcome.
change.failureRegression: Coverage includes hook error, hook panic, callback error, and reopening the unresolved intent in a fresh test process, which refuses replay and later effects.

focusedNewTests.includesFreshProcessTest: TestRunEffectBeforeOutcomeFailureSurvivesFreshProcess passed; it starts a second test process that rejects replay and any later effect while the intent remains unresolved.

limitations: This verifies audit-journal ordering and failure semantics only.
